data.summary: This 10‑week plan tackles the student’s weak units first, interleaves new material, and ends with a mixed review and timed practice. Each week is a single, focused session of 6 hours, with concrete tasks and optional live class attendance when available.
data.final_week_advice: Use the last week for full-length practice exams and a thorough review of all units, focusing on problem areas identified during the plan.

tasks: Do 15 practice problems on mole calculations and convert between mass and moles, then check answers with the scoring guide.
Watch a 30‑minute video on electron configuration and solve 10 related questions.
Create a flashcard set for key periodic trends from 1.7.

weeks.focus: Deep dive into kinetics with live class
tasks: Attend live class 9000 and take detailed notes.
After class, solve 20 rate law problems, marking each with the rubric.
Summarize the relationship between concentration and rate in a 3‑sentence paragraph.
Complete a stoichiometry worksheet with 25 problems.
Convert 10 reactions into net ionic equations and verify with 4.2.
Attend live class 9001 and record key points.
Work through 15 equilibrium constant calculations, including Q and K comparisons.
Create a concept map linking direction of reversible reactions to Q and K.
Draw 10 energy diagrams for endothermic and exothermic reactions.
Solve 12 calorimetry problems, noting heat transfer direction.
Calculate pH and pOH for 10 strong acid/base solutions.
Solve 8 buffer capacity problems and record results.
Attend live class 9002 and take notes on weak acid equilibria.
Complete 12 weak acid/base equilibrium calculations, including Ka and pKa.
Write a short essay on entropy change in spontaneous reactions.
Solve 10 Gibbs free energy problems, noting ΔG, ΔH, and ΔS.
Do a 60‑minute timed practice test covering all listed topics.
Review incorrect answers and update flashcards accordingly.
Take a full 90‑minute AP Chemistry practice exam under timed conditions.
Score the exam, identify top 3 weak areas, and plan a brief review session for each.
